notes_sections.heading: October 5 full-read pass
items: S.i. Systems shows only 20 cards per query regardless of the result count (55 for Infrastructure Engineer), and the page has no working pager, so the first run’s ‘first 8 per query’ left most of each query unread. This pass collected up to 20 cards for each of 13 queries (DevOps Engineer, Site Reliability/SRE, Platform, Cloud, Infrastructure, Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, DevSecOps…), de-duplicated to 44 postings and fetched every detail page (/jobs/<slug>/<id>/, which returns the full description to a normal browser fetch). New finds were all non-qualifying: a Cloud Platform Engineer (Azure DevOps + Bicep IaC, remote, 10+ years) is a one-month contract that ended July 31 (listing stale); a Kubernetes Engineer in Toronto (max $93/hr, clearance flag) is outside the reachable cities.

Carry-over roles (Senior IT Application Specialist – filed; Platform Engineer 58102; SRE 6+; bare-metal Infrastructure Engineer; AWS Cloud Engineer; DevOps Director with SECRET; Azure/Databricks Oshawa; Crown Corp DevSecOps – Applied) were re-read and are unchanged.

items: A first pass completed 2 of 8 queries (DevOps Engineer, Senior DevOps Engineer) before hitting a session budget limit; a follow-up completed the remaining 6 and merged results.
S.i. Systems' Networks and Infrastructure category is a small, static pool (~15-20 distinct live postings recurring across all query rankings, since q= is only a soft ranking signal per the skill).

Cloud Engineer and DevSecOps Engineer each surfaced one new plausible candidate within the first-8 boundary: Network Analyst III (Toronto, WAN/LAN/Firewall/QoS troubleshooting) was screened out by title/summary alone. Senior Cloud Platform Engineer (8-10 years) (Job ID 154794) was opened, read in full, and scored -1/Ineligible below — real Azure/Terraform/Ansible/Databricks skill match, but Toronto Hybrid 4 days/week is outside the reachable-city range.
All retrieval was via a real browser, read-only; no application, account, or form action was used. No CAPTCHA encountered.

method: Oct 13 (complete, 8 of 8 queries): nothing within 24 hours. Oct 12 (complete, 8 of 8 queries). Current descriptions and applications.md statuses were reconciled; 12 previously validated rows remain, with no new eligible role and no inaccessible posting.
